A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EvoLM study. Their text, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite renumbering, relocation, and formatting changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original model-training experiments, benchmark evaluations, scaling studies, controlled comparisons, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains the original experimental results in the main text and appendices, including benchmark scores, scaling curves, and statistical reporting.

M1.justification: The architecture and pre-training, replay-based CPT, SFT, and PPO procedures are unchanged. Prompt filtering is renamed from model 'mutual agreement' to 'correctness consistency,' while retaining the stated zero-inter-model-consensus exclusion rule.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training corpora, six upstream benchmarks, and six downstream datasets. The mathematical, code, logical, tabular, and commonsense reasoning coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains the same OPT, Pythia, TinyLlama, Llama, and Qwen comparator variants. The SFT-only, no-CPT, no-replay, and intermediate-versus-complete-checkpoint comparisons are also retained.

E3.justification: Token budgets, model sizes, dataset-size and epoch sweeps, SFT/RL allocations, checkpoint controls, and decoding settings remain unchanged. Expanded captions restate settings already documented in v1; they do not establish new protocols.

E4.justification: Replay sensitivity, SFT/RL allocation, intermediate-checkpoint comparisons, ORM/perplexity correlations, response-length analyses, and the three example outputs are retained. V1 Appendix B becomes v2 Appendix A without adding or removing these analyses.

E5.justification: V1 Section C.3.2 and v2 Section B.3.2 both report four experiments with different random seeds. Table 9 retains identical standard-error entries and reporting practices.

E6.justification: Matched numerical tables, plotted results, and example outputs are unchanged. For example, the CPT comparison retains GSM8K-Platinum accuracies of 21.01% with 8B replay plus 42B FineMath and 19.27% with FineMath alone, moving from v1 Table 1 to v2 Table 2.

T1.justification: The empirical metric definitions and mathematical reasoning are unchanged. Neither version supplies a theoretical development or proof that is added, removed, or revised in the other.

C1.justification: Both retain the same model-suite contributions and claims about diminishing returns, CPT and replay, SFT/RL trade-offs, and ORM-based evaluation. V1's standalone upstream-saturation takeaway disappears, but its substantive conclusion remains in Section 3.1.

C2.justification: The conclusion now explicitly characterizes the study as qualitative analysis and calls for searching for more optimal hyperparameters. The existing model-scale, task-scope, and PPO limitations, along with the result interpretations, remain.

D1.justification: V2 supplements the project-page access point with direct dataset-collection and code-repository links on the first page. Architecture, hyperparameters, hardware, training schedules, prompts, and inference details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction adds Dominguez-Olmedo et al. on evaluation confounding and Tissue et al. on learning-rate annealing. The expanded Section 5 otherwise incorporates the existing related-work discussion from v1 Appendix A, preserving its research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 makes limited wording edits, converts the model-signature explanation into bullets, integrates appendix related work into Section 5, and adopts numbered citations. Most explanatory prose and the scientific narrative remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 adds an overview diagram as Figure 1 and substantially reformats the document into the NeurIPS layout. Several existing figures and tables become smaller displays wrapped by text, captions separate model configurations into lists, and takeaways receive new styling. Existing experimental graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: The new overview, clearer configuration captions, direct code and dataset links, and explicit hyperparameter qualification modestly improve orientation, access, and scope clarification. Experimental support remains unchanged. The denser layout makes some displays, especially Table 3, smaller, limiting the overall presentation gain.
